original_English: Trace affected sections through CRs referenced by resolutions (decision-to-section tracing).
original_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR) WHERE cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND cr.clausesAffected <> '' MATCH (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, cr.clausesAffected, sp.specNumber ORDER BY r.resolutionId, cr.tdocNumber, sp.specNumber LIMIT 10

original_Korean_record.question: Resolution이 참조한 CR의 clausesAffected를 통한 Section 추적은?

actual_lines.text: rdfs:comment "A 3GPP Technical Specification (TS) or Technical Report (TR). v4.1 (release-aware, hybrid) — a Spec exists in two roles. (1) ABSTRACT HUB: one node per specNumber (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211), no tdoc:specRelease; the stable target of release-blind document references — Tdoc/CR MODIFIES & AFFECTS_CORE_SPEC, TRImpact IMPACTS_SPEC/SPEC_IMPACTED_BY (a CR modifies 'the spec', not a single release). (2) RELEASE-KEYED: one node per (specNumber, release) (IRI tdoc:spec/{specNumber_}/{release}, e.g. tdoc:spec/38_211/Rel-15), carries tdoc:specInRelease + tdoc:specRelease + that release's specVersion; the parent of release-specific Sections (BELONGS_TO_SPEC/HAS_SECTION); linked to its hub via tdoc:inReleaseOf. This hybrid preserves release-blind reference edges intact (no re-keying) while giving each release's Sections a release-keyed parent. Pre-v4.0 had a single specNumber node (latest snapshot); v4.0 had only release-keyed nodes (broke hub references) — v4.1 restores the hub additively."@en .

| 4-1 | 특정 Resolution이 승인한 CR이 수정한 TS는? | Resolution → CR → Spec |
| 4-2 | 특정 TS를 수정한 CR을 승인한 Resolution 목록은? | Spec ← CR ← Resolution |
| 4-3 | 특정 회의에서 승인된 CR이 수정한 TS 목록은? | Meeting → Resolution → CR → Spec |
| 4-4 | 특정 Work Item의 Resolution이 반영된 TS 목록은? | WorkItem → CR ← Resolution, CR → Spec |
*CQ4 제약사항: Resolution이 CR을 references하는 경우만 (Phase-2 Appendix A [P2-V07] 참조)*
Phase-1 CR의 clausesAffected 속성을 파싱하여 Section 식별:
- CR의 modifies → Spec에서 specNumber 확인 + CR의 대상 release 확인
- 나머지 CR은 Spec 레벨까지만 연결 (CR → Spec)

input_SQLs.references:
SELECT DISTINCT r.node_id AS resolutionNodeId,r.resolutionId,
        cr.node_id AS crNodeId,cr.tdocNumber,cr.clausesAffected,
        cr.crNumber,cr.status FROM Resolution r
        JOIN rel_REFERENCES z ON z.src_id=r.node_id JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=z.dst_id
        ORDER BY r.resolutionId,cr.tdocNumber
input_SQLs.CR_targets:
SELECT DISTINCT cr.node_id AS crNodeId,cr.tdocNumber,sp.node_id AS specNodeId,
        sp.specNumber,sp.specRelease,trg.node_id AS releaseNodeId,trg.releaseName
        FROM CR cr JOIN rel_MODIFIES m ON m.src_id=cr.node_id
        JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=m.dst_id
        LEFT JOIN rel_TARGET_RELEASE tr ON tr.src_id=cr.node_id
        LEFT JOIN Release trg ON trg.node_id=tr.dst_id
        WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM Resolution r JOIN rel_REFERENCES z ON z.src_id=r.node_id
          WHERE z.dst_id=cr.node_id) ORDER BY cr.tdocNumber,sp.specNumber,sp.specRelease,trg.releaseName
input_SQLs.Section_dictionary:
SELECT DISTINCT s.node_id AS sectionNodeId,s.sectionId,s.sectionNumber,
        s.sectionTitle,s.level,sp.node_id AS ownerSpecNodeId,sp.specNumber,sp.specRelease,sp.specVersion
        FROM Section s JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC b ON b.src_id=s.node_id
        JOIN Spec sp ON sp.node_id=b.dst_id ORDER BY s.sectionId

original_source_scope_challenges: English and exact Korean CQ ask documentary tracing of affected Sections through CRs referenced by Resolutions; later current design CQ4-3 mapping table has a different meeting-approved wording and is not adopted as replacement English.
REFERENCES denotes a Tdoc citation in Resolution content, not approval, implementation, enacted effect or causal influence. Query must not import any such predicate or interpretation.

Original §7.2 parses recorded Phase1 clausesAffected and matches Section by CR targetRelease and modifying logical specNumber. Retained MODIFIES_SECTION fallback-le/fwd implementation is not automatic exact-release authority.

Derive requested trace roles before projecting: relationship tuples may require Resolution, CR and Section identities to preserve trace, whereas plain unassociated Section set could erase paths. Old raw field RETURN is not automatic required field authority.

All244 field values must be examined for literal suffixes, terminal punctuation, new annotations, whitespace/semicolon separation, embedded numeric IDs in descriptors, explicit ranges and placeholders. ANY witness sufficiency for CR-list sibling does not prove full Section trace completeness.

Do not silently fix 91.1.1.7, 8.13,14,2 or invent wildcard expansion for X/Y placeholders. Exact recorded Section identities and documented same-release rule define successful resolution; unresolved or external-spec absence is not physical authored Section absence.

No proposed output tuples, matching answer counts, primary judgment, native, gold, predictions, external API or admission is included. All inputs are nonblind AI development evidence, not model measurement or expert review.
